title: DeepSeek LLM: Scaling Open-Source Language Models with Longtermism
before: Scaling laws were published by Western labs and taken on trust by everyone else.
problem: The published coefficients did not transfer cleanly to other data and hyperparameter regimes.
breakthrough: Their own scaling study on their own data, used to size 7B and 67B open models.
why: The opening move of the lab that would later ship R1 and V3, and a reminder that scaling laws are data-dependent.
next: DeepSeekMoE, DeepSeekMath and the V2 and V3 architectures.
inherits: Scaling laws as something you measure for your own setup.
